measurements.evidence_quote: The zeta potential of 460 nm PS particles was -2.2 ± 0.1 mV (Fig. 2G–F), while the zeta potentials of the other PS particles were closer to zero. || PS particles were dispersed in PBS (pH 7.4), and their surface charges were determined via zeta potential analysis using a Zetasizer (Malvern Instruments, UK). || PS particles with small negative charges tended to move closer to one another as the ionic strength of NaCl increased to 137 mM in PBS buffer.
measurements.evidence_location: Characterization of PS particles; Methods; Discussion
